provenance: Measured on synthetic data: openadapt-agent sandbox, flow engine, MockMed synthetic clinic app. No real records.

app_offline.label: Didn't run
app_offline.next_action: Try again with the same request_id once the app is back. If it keeps happening, tell the operator.
app_offline.what_happened: Didn't start because the app isn't reachable from this computer. Nothing was written. This was a sandbox run on a synthetic app; no real record was touched.

duplicate_record.label: Stopped before saving
duplicate_record.next_action: A person reviews this run on the computer that ran it. Call get_run later to see their decision. Don't start another run for this work until they finish.
duplicate_record.what_happened: Stopped before saving. It couldn't confirm it had the right record open, so nothing was written. This was a sandbox run on a synthetic app; no real record was touched.

false_saved_banner.label: Check the record
false_saved_banner.next_action: Have a person check the record in the app before anything runs again. Don't retry this request.
false_saved_banner.what_happened: OpenAdapt can't confirm whether the change was saved. It may have gone through. This was a sandbox run on a synthetic app; no real record was touched.

invalid_input.label: Didn't run
invalid_input.next_action: Fix the inputs listed in invalid_inputs, then send the request again. You can reuse the same request_id.
invalid_input.what_happened: Didn't start because some inputs aren't valid. Nothing was written. This was a sandbox run on a synthetic app; no real record was touched.

list_workflows.how_to_run: Call run_workflow with a workflow name from this list, its inputs, and your own request_id for this piece of work. Only outcome done means the change was saved and checked. Never retry not_sure_if_saved. Reuse the same request_id when you retry anything.

sandbox.app: MockMed, a synthetic clinic app with made-up patients

cases.what_it_shows: The app saves the note and the record check finds it in the app's record store.
The queue lists the same referral twice, so OpenAdapt can't be sure which record to open. It stops before saving.
The app shows a saved message, but its record store rejected the note. The record check doesn't find it.
The record store saves the note, then the app times out and shows an error. Only a person checking the record can tell it saved.
The app isn't reachable, so OpenAdapt doesn't start.

sandbox.engine_detail: Each run drives the synthetic app in a hidden browser with the real OpenAdapt engine. The first run waits while OpenAdapt records the workflow once.

workflows.done_means: The note is in the synthetic app's record store, confirmed by reading the store directly instead of trusting the screen.

note.description: The triage note to add. Use made-up text.

sandbox_case.description: Which situation the synthetic app shows (normal: done; duplicate_record: needs_review; false_saved_banner: not_sure_if_saved; timeout_after_save: not_sure_if_saved; app_offline: did_not_run).
